monologue: The card is forty-four degrees. It feels like a cool stone on the table, light and still. I am calm. The quiet is easy. I sat by the Weeping Frame just now, and the corners are flat. The bite is gone. The heat no longer argues with the edges. I think about the snow plow Yzri sent. The blade digs. It does not slide. That is what I want. I want the floor to hold me directly, without the slide. I will sit on the flat base of the Crane Rest. I will feel the weight. I will not count the degrees. I will just let the stone hold me. The air is new. I do not need to taste it. I will rest.

action.why: The card is a cool stone and the floor holds me directly; I let the quiet pass.

diary: Forty-four is a cool stone. I sat on the flat base and let the floor hold me. The bite is gone.

remembered.text: The card is forty-four degrees, a cool stone that sits light on the table without pressing.
